items.title: AI solution can help nearly 1 in 5 patients avoid prostate biopsies, RadNet says
items.excerpt: RadNet says its AI solution could help nearly 1 in 5 patients avoid prostate biopsies, supporting clinicians at 'one of the most consequential decision points in prostate care.'

items.title: Physicians fire back against HHS secretary’s claim AI is ‘better informed’ than human docs
items.excerpt: Physician groups pushed back after HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said AI is 'better informed' than human doctors and could 'free us from medical tyranny.'

items.title: Radiology AI authorizations rise 42% as regulatory landscape evolves
items.excerpt: A new analysis of FDA's AI-enabled device database finds radiology AI authorizations up 42%, detailing how the regulatory standing of imaging AI has shifted.

items.title: Abridge, University of Texas System enter enterprise-wide agreement for expanded AI-enabled care
items.excerpt: Abridge is expanding its ambient clinical AI platform across the University of Texas System through an enterprise-wide agreement with UT REAL Health AI.

items.title: Weekly Rundown: Nextech taps Assort Health, EliseAI for agentic AI; Elsevier rolls out clinical AI tool for nurses
items.excerpt: Weekly health-tech brief: HHS awards $15M for AI projects, Nextech taps Assort Health and EliseAI for agentic AI, and Elsevier rolls out a clinical AI tool for nurses.

items.title: FDA to prioritize guidance on AI, surgical robots next year
items.excerpt: FDA's 2027 guidance agenda prioritizes finalizing advice for AI-enabled devices, drafting generative-AI device guidance, and new guidance for surgical robots.

items.title: Data privacy concerns could hold patients back from using AI
items.excerpt: A new survey finds patients are increasingly worried about their health data, a privacy concern that could hold them back from using AI in their care.

items.title: AI Can Flag Cognitive Decline Earlier — Health Systems Still Own What Happens Next - MedCity News
items.excerpt: Earlier AI detection of cognitive decline is valuable, but it creates a duty that does not end when an alert appears in the electronic health record, so health systems must own what happens next.

items.title: An open vision-language model for diverse medical applications
items.excerpt: MedGemma, a collection of open medical vision-language foundation models built on Google's Gemma 3, demonstrates advanced medical understanding and reasoning across diverse clinical applications.

items.title: The complexity paradox of generalist AI agents in medicine: exploring GPT-5 for real-world  multimodal medical diagnosis
items.excerpt: A systematic test of ten GPT-5-based agent configurations on real-world multimodal diagnostic cases finds a 'complexity paradox': more tools and reasoning steps don't reliably improve accuracy.

items.title: Early prediction of prolonged ICU stay in sepsis patients using an explainable hybrid deep learning model
items.excerpt: An explainable hybrid deep learning model predicts prolonged ICU stay in sepsis patients early, outperforming the clinical severity scores now in use.

items.title: FDA spells out 2027 AI guidance plans
items.excerpt: STAT Health Tech: FDA lays out the AI guidances it expects to issue in 2027, as Utah expands its health AI regulatory sandbox.

history_match.title: Utah approves slew of health AI pilots for drug management, women's health

items.title: HHS announces new efforts to speed up, expand clinical trials with AI
items.excerpt: HHS and ARPA-H announce new efforts to use AI to speed up and expand clinical trials, framed as a bid to compete with countries like China.

items.title: Why health AI pilots in Utah may be on a collision course with the FDA
items.excerpt: Utah's AI sandbox lets pilots like AI prescription renewals run under state waivers, but unresolved questions over FDA device rules could put them on a collision course with federal regulators.

history_match.title: Utah approves slew of health AI pilots for drug management, women's health

items.title: AI 신약개발 'K-멜로디' 사업, 종료 후 운영계획 부실 지적
items.excerpt: 348억원이 투입된 AI 신약개발 지원사업 'K-멜로디'가 사업 종료 후 운영계획과 핵심 성과 관리가 부실하다는 국정감사 지적을 받았다.

items.title: Study in The Lancet suggests AI could improve patient-physician relationships.
items.excerpt: A peer-reviewed prospective study in The Lancet evaluated Google's conversational diagnostic AI AMIE with real patients in an ambulatory primary care clinic, suggesting it could improve patient-physician relationships.

items.title: 서울아산병원 연구팀, 피부색 변환 AI ‘STTN’ 개발
items.excerpt: 서울아산병원 김남국 교수팀이 밝은 피부의 병변 형태를 유지한 채 피부색만 어둡게 바꾸는 생성형 AI를 개발해, 피부색에 따른 AI 피부질환 진단 성능 격차를 줄였다.

items.title: 온코소프트, ASTRO 2026서 AI 방사선치료 솔루션 공개
items.excerpt: 온코소프트가 미국 보스턴에서 열린 미국방사선종양학회 ASTRO 2026에 참가해 차세대 AI 방사선치료 솔루션을 선보였다.

items.title: 서울아산병원 소아 신속대응시스템에 들어온 AI…고위험 환아 조기 선별
items.excerpt: 서울아산병원 박유경 교수는 소아 신속대응시스템(RRS)에 도입된 뷰노 AI가 고위험 환아를 조기에 선별하는 데 도움이 된다고 밝혔다.

items.title: 에이아이트릭스, 미측정 정보로 환자 악화 예측…연구논문 게재
items.excerpt: 에이아이트릭스의 환자 악화 예측 AI 모델 MADE가 EHR의 미측정 정보까지 활용해 악화를 예측한 논문이 국제학술지 JAMIA에 게재됐다.

items.title: 코어라인소프트, 일본 학회 인증…영상진단 가산수가 기반 확보
items.excerpt: 코어라인소프트의 폐결절 진단보조 AI 'AVIEW Lung Nodule CAD'가 PMDA 승인에 이어 일본의학방사선학회 AI 인증을 받아 영상진단 가산수가 적용 기반을 확보했다.

items.title: Chatbot Intervention and Cancer Risk Knowledge in Adolescents and Young Adults With Cancer Predisposition
items.excerpt: A four-center randomized clinical trial (Dana-Farber, Emory, UChicago, Huntsman) tested an electronic chatbot cancer-risk communication tool for adolescents and young adults with hereditary cancer predisposition.
